verdict.rationale: AvaTax documents a CreateTransaction API that records taxable actions such as sales, purchases and returns, which a developer could use for API backfills. It also claims consistent handling across ecommerce, marketplace, POS and ERP systems regardless of where transactions originate, and a separate Managed Returns API covers filing. However, nothing documents bulk historical import, connector syncs from other payment processors or storefronts, or that recorded transactions flow into filings. missing for 10: documented bulk/backfill import tooling, named connectors syncing transactions from other processors and storefronts, explicit linkage of imported transactions to returns filing, hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, transactions from every channel can be imported — API backfills and connector syncs from other processors and storefronts — so filings cover my whole business, not just one integration

citations.quote: Records a new transaction in AvaTax. A transaction represents a unique potentially taxable action that your company has recorded
transactions include actions like sales, purchases, inventory transfer, and returns
Apply consistent tax logic across ecommerce, marketplace, POS, and ERP systems so transactions return accurate totals regardless of where they originate.
Avalara Managed Returns API enables partners and platforms to embed tax return preparation and filing into their workflows.
